name: canvas-accessibility-auditor
tagline_zh: Canvas 课程暗藏 WCAG 违规？一键扫描生成优先级报告，还能手把手指导修复并验证。别等学生投诉。
tagline_en: Scan Canvas courses for WCAG violations, get prioritized fixes, and verify them—before students complain.
desc_en: Accessibility audit and remediation for Canvas LMS courses. Scans content for WCAG violations, generates prioritized reports, guides fixes, and verifies remediation. Use when asked to "audit accessibility", "check WCAG compliance", "fix accessibility issues", or "run accessibility review".
why_zh: 同类工具只报错，它却陪你改完并复检，把审计闭环做成一条龙。
why_en: Unlike scanners that only flag issues, it guides fixes and re-verifies—closing the loop end-to-end.
